iko.text: Lukka, a Coppercoat of Drannith, is ordered to kill a threat but chooses to make a friend, bonding with a winged cat, and after he is dishonorably discharged and banned from the city, Vivien Reid rescues and befriends him.
At the Ozolith, Lukka touches the crystal and gains great but unbalanced power, forms an army of beasts and tries to take control of the bonders' monsters, so Vivien flees with the bonders.
He then stabs General Kudro to death at a parley and marches on Drannith, but Jirina's strategy and the bonders turn the tide, and Vivien's summoned monstrosaur helps to surround him.
The Ozolith explodes when he overloads it, severing him from his beasts and igniting his spark, and he planeswalks away from Ikoria.
